translations.web: Turn at my reproof. Behold, I will pour out my spirit on you. I will make known my words to you.
translations.bsb: If you had repented at my rebuke, then surely I would have poured out my spirit on you; I would have made my words known to you.
translations.kjv: Turn you at my reproof: behold, I will pour out my spirit unto you, I will make known my words
translations.asv: Turn you at my reproof: Behold, I will pour out my spirit upon you; I will make known my words unto you.
